NO bracelet, NO watch, nothing on the wrist. The hand enters from the frame edge with the wrist touching the edge; the forearm stays outside the frame. Copy it exactly: no plug, no handles, no extra parts, no extra text, no colour change. Setting: a bright, clean family bathroom lit by soft daylight from a frosted window on the left: pale powder-blue square ceramic wall tiles with thin white grout, a white glossy built-in alcove bathtub with a chrome wall-mounted tap, a light oak slatted bath mat on a pale grey stone floor. Bright, neutral, true-white colour balance: no yellow, no golden, no dark or moody look, no vignette. Realistic iPhone UGC photo, sharp, natural, slight depth of field.
